skill.description: Guides agents through creating and updating AI skills with structured discovery, reusable resources, validation, and packaging workflows.
skill.summary: Create and improve AI skills with guided structure, templates, validation, and packaging.
skill.author: Joseph OBrien

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown code fences, inline paths, and validation messages. One medium-risk packaging behavior remains because the zip packager includes every file under the selected skill directory, which can disclose local artifacts if the directory contains secrets.

remediation.suggestion: Exclude credentials, environment files, VCS metadata, caches, generated archives, and temporary files before writing the skill zip.

remediation.issue: Packaging scope depends on user-selected directories
remediation.suggestion: Document that users should package only reviewed skill folders and inspect the archive contents before sharing.

content.value_statement: Building AI skills is hard to structure consistently. This skill guides discovery, design, validation, and packaging for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
actual_capabilities: Explains how to define clear skill purpose, triggers, and user examples.
Guides selection of scripts, references, and assets for reusable skill resources.
Provides initialization guidance through bundled skill scaffolding scripts.
Describes how to write SKILL.md frontmatter, body instructions, and resource references.
Documents validation and packaging steps for a completed skill.
limitations: It provides guidance and local scripts, not a full marketplace submission workflow.
The helper scripts create, validate, and package local files only.
Generated templates still require human review and domain-specific editing.
It does not prove that a completed skill is safe for automatic installation.

use_cases.title: Create a New Skill
use_cases.description: Define the skill purpose, choose reusable resources, scaffold files, and prepare a complete SKILL.md.

use_cases.title: Improve an Existing Skill
use_cases.description: Review metadata, remove placeholder content, clarify workflows, and align resources with real user tasks.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Skill Package
use_cases.description: Validate the folder structure and create a distributable archive after reviewing included files.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Simple Skill
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner user creating a first skill.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to help me create a new AI skill for summarizing weekly team updates. Ask only the essential setup questions first.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Skill Resources
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate user deciding what files a skill needs.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to design reusable scripts, references, and assets for a PDF reporting skill. Explain which resources are necessary.

prompt_templates.title: Review Existing Skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to review my existing skill folder for unclear triggers, placeholder text, resource gaps, and validation issues.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Marketplace Package
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to validate, package, and review a completed skill for marketplace readiness. Call out risks before creating the archive.

output_examples.input: Create a skill for reviewing incident reports.
output_examples.output: A concise skill plan with purpose, trigger conditions, reusable references, validation steps, and sections for the final skill instructions.

output_examples.input: Improve this draft skill before sharing it.
output_examples.output: A review that identifies weak metadata, missing examples, unnecessary resources, placeholder text, and concrete edits for the skill author.
A validation result, packaging checklist, archive location, and warning to inspect included files before sharing.

best_practices: Start from concrete user tasks before writing workflow instructions.
Keep SKILL.md concise and move detailed knowledge into references when needed.
Validate the skill and inspect packaged contents before distribution.
anti_patterns: Do not keep generic placeholder text in published skill instructions.
Do not add scripts, references, or assets that are unrelated to the skill workflow.
Do not package a skill folder before removing secrets, caches, and temporary files.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps create or update AI skills with clear triggers, workflows, reusable resources, validation, and packaging steps.

faq.question: Does it work with Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The marketplace report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it generate a finished skill automatically?
faq.answer: It can scaffold and guide a skill, but the author must add domain knowledge and review the result.

faq.question: Can it include helper scripts?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains when scripts are useful and includes local helper scripts for scaffolding, validation, and packaging.

faq.question: What should authors check before packaging?
faq.answer: Authors should validate the skill, remove placeholders, and confirm the folder contains no secrets or temporary files.

faq.question: Is this a security review tool?
faq.answer: No. It improves skill structure and packaging, but separate security review is still required before publication.
